note: Names and official descriptions are the game's own trophy text. Every guide below is written for this guide in our own words. Hidden flags follow the usual PSN spoiler convention (story and secret moments stay masked until earned); missable flags mean 'do it when the moment comes' — nothing here is confirmed permanently missable.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap stages in order and let the Next Up tab pick the cheapest remaining trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: An early story mission: follow the fishing tutorial, keep the line tension in the safe zone and reel steadily when the fish runs. It pops when the mission ends, so you cannot miss it by playing the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story progress only — no side work needed, and the trophy is unmissable.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Unmissable story progress; it pops on the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable story progress; it pops on the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Unmissable story progress; it pops on the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the story to its finale and finish the last mission. Do it before the big cleanup stages — the finale unlocks free roam with everything open, which is when the grind trophies get easiest.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story mission in the early chapters. Just play it through; the trophy pops at the mission's end and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story heist mission. Follow the setup steps the mission gives you, then the heist itself — the trophy pops when the crew gets away clean.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story mission. Play it through to the end; unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story mission. Play it through to the end; unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story mission at the airport. Play it through to the end; unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story mission. Play it through to the end; unmissable story progress.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The last gold: 100% means the story plus every activity, collectible, stranger strand and challenge the game counts. Use the checklist to find the stragglers — in practice the last few percent are almost always stunts, cards or WAiNK tags.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunt jumps count cumulatively across the whole map, so chip away at them whenever you pass a ramp. Take a fast bike, use the stunt markers, and land cleanly — a failed landing does not count.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample everything once: one fishing trip, one race, one shooting-range round, one arcade game, one drone race, one meditation, one hunt. You only need to try each type, not win it — a single attempt ticks the box.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The hardest silver. Each range challenge shows its gold threshold in the menu — learn one weapon at a time, and redo the timed challenges until the gold time sticks. Bring the range's recommended loadout instead of your favourite gun.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each Top Fun spot on the map. Learn the gate layout first at low speed, then race it — cutting corners tight matters more than top speed.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events — each event counts once, repeats do not. The race menu shows which you have won, so work through the un-won list and vary the vehicle class to match each event.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal at a fishing spot and out-fish him. Match the bait to the spot, keep tension in the green band, and reel in short bursts when the fish dives — steady beats fast here.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish any arcade cabinet game once — any title, any score. Walk up to a cabinet, play it to its end screen, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: meet Andy, then work through every mission he offers until his finale. Stranger missions appear as marked encounters — finish the strand to its last mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: work through all of Kenton's missions to his finale. Check the map for his marker whenever you are nearby.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: work through all of Billy's missions to his finale. Each step unlocks the next, so keep returning to his marker.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger strands end to end. The guide lists every strand giver; a strand counts only when its finale mission is done, so partial strands do not count.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: work through all of Randy's missions to his finale.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger strand: work through all of Tyrone's missions to his finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find every meditation spot and sit through a full session at each. Spots reveal on the map as you explore, and the counter ticks only on a completed session — do not walk away mid-meditation.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret points you at one unique animal in a marked territory. Track it with the hunting senses, approach downwind so it does not bolt, and take the shot clean — a bow or a scoped rifle works best.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Cards hide all over Leonida — shops, gloveboxes, rooftops, mission rewards. A set counts when every card in it is found; the guide lists the sets so you can chase the missing cards instead of wandering.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Tag 100 WAiNK spots with the spray. Marked walls count once tagged, and the map tracks your total — sweep district by district instead of criss-crossing the state.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Any 50 challenges from the challenge list count — stunts, races, combat, exploration. Pick the easy half first and let the counter climb while you play; the challenge menu shows exactly what is left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight together and stay hidden until it clears. Do it in the countryside where cover is close — the city gives you nowhere to hide. Flagged watch-out: grab it when the chance comes, not after the story moves on.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, hit three shops in a row while the wanted level stays up. Plan the route first, keep the getaway car close, and do not stop to fight — speed between shops is the whole trick. Flagged watch-out: do it while you have a partner window, not after.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Enter or drive 100 distinct vehicles and the log ticks each new one. Traffic variety does most of the work — check car meets, docks and rare spawns for the last few.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus once and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a dense shootout, line the targets up first, then fire — five quick, aimed shots beat spraying.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At the airport, take a plane and leave without clearance — steal one from the runway and get airborne. The trophy pops once you are clear of VCIA airspace.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and stir up heat until the moment lands. Wanted level plus a tank plus a busy street is the recipe — keep moving so the army cannot box you in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Go in quiet: night, no alarm, no witnesses. Slip past the cameras, crack the cases, and leave before anyone looks up. If the alarm trips, walk out and try again another night. Flagged watch-out: a loud attempt does not lock it out, but a clean run is the point.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Five bank vault jobs, each with a full escape. Scout the bank, plan the exit route before you go in, and do not stop for the loot on the floor once the alarm is up — the escape is the hard half.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Block an armored truck, crack the rear doors, grab the cash and lose the heat. A sticky bomb on the doors works; so does ramming it into a wall. Either way, have the getaway car ready before you start.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every district and region until the map is filled in. The region list in this guide shows what is left — mop up the corners last, especially the islands and the far north.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation per gang. Operations reveal once scouted, so work the map gang by gang and clear the last one only when every gang has an op marked.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean Beach bar viewpoint, order the cocktail and let the moment play out. A quiet one — no shooting, no timer, just sit and watch the water.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive through the showroom glass and out the front, in the classic style. Any fast car works — line it up, floor it, and do not brake for the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl a full game at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through to the end. Any score counts — finishing the game is what pops it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal to the top by doing things together — activities, jobs, free roam time. It climbs while you play as a pair, so it lands naturally if you keep your partner along.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A story decision point: pick a path and live with it. The trophy pops once the choice plays out. Flagged watch-out: this is a one-time story choice, so think before you pick — there is no undo in the same playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Fail a moment, then nail it on the retry — the trophy pops on the second successful attempt. Flagged watch-out: it needs a failed first try at the right moment, so do not force it; it comes naturally if you retry instead of reloading an old save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A strange encounter out in Leonida — investigate the odd marker when it appears and follow it to the end. Keep an eye on the map for anything that does not belong.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, swing a melee weapon and knock targets down. Ten pins means ten knockdowns — a slow cruise through a crowded sidewalk with a bat does it. Flagged watch-out: it needs a vehicle and a crowd, so set it up deliberately.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from heists and robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Keep the pipeline running between jobs — it pays out over time, not all at once.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Cumulative spending at every shop counts — cars, clothes, weapons, food. Buy what you actually use and the counter climbs on its own; the big car purchases finish it off.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. The property site lists them all — work through the list and check the map for any you have not bought yet.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register ten vehicles you own. Any ten count — register the cheap ones first and the trophy pops on the tenth.
trophies.name: On the Spot
